scope: paired absolute native Android checklist measurements from actual swipes, one exact development APK, one isolated API 36 arm64 emulator

method.dataset: One seeded synthetic project, titles Pump 0001 onward with position, responsible name and deterministic task IDs. Both dataset variants start with zero completed tasks and share the same first 20 rows.
method.coldStart: Activity Manager TotalTime for the ordinary launcher after am force-stop. Each reported row was COLD in Activity Manager output.
method.memory: Android dumpsys meminfo total PSS and RSS after the expected page labels were visible and before the swipe.
method.scroll: Reset gfxinfo, send one 790 ms swipe from [525,1600] to [525,380], wait 450 ms, collect framestats, then require a fresh hierarchy and new visible task labels.
method.frameMetric: Per Flags=0 frame, positive finite FrameCompleted minus IntendedVsync. Report the median and range of the five individual p95 results. The frame interval was 16,666,666 ns.
method.readback: Seed and final workspace bytes matched on every trial. The app displayed the expected first page for 20 and 1,000 tasks, and the swipe revealed new task labels.
method.comparisonLimit: One development APK on a 60 Hz emulated display and a shared host. Both variants render 20 items per page. Timing variation exceeds the median gap. Tap-to-visible latency and minimum-device frame budgets remain unverified.
